93 /**
94 * A vector-like sequence container providing front and back operations
95 * (e.g: `push_front`/`pop_front`/`push_back`/`pop_back`) with amortized constant complexity.
96 *
97 * Models the [SequenceContainer], [ReversibleContainer], and [AllocatorAwareContainer] concepts.
98 *
99 * **Requires**:
100 * - `T` shall be [MoveInsertable] into the devector.
101 * - `T` shall be [Erasable] from any `devector<T, allocator_type, GP>`.
102 * - `GrowthFactor`, and `Allocator` must model the concepts with the same names or be void.
103 *
104 * **Definition**: `T` is `NothrowConstructible` if it's either nothrow move constructible or
105 * nothrow copy constructible.
106 *
107 * **Definition**: `T` is `NothrowAssignable` if it's either nothrow move assignable or
108 * nothrow copy assignable.
109 *
110 * **Exceptions**: The exception specifications assume `T` is nothrow [Destructible].
111 *
112 * Most methods providing the strong exception guarantee assume `T` either has a move
113 * constructor marked noexcept or is [CopyInsertable] into the devector. If it isn't true,
114 * and the move constructor throws, the guarantee is waived and the effects are unspecified.
115 *
116 * In addition to the exceptions specified in the **Throws** clause, the following operations
117 * of `T` can throw when any of the specified concept is required:
118 * - [DefaultInsertable][]: Default constructor
119 * - [MoveInsertable][]: Move constructor
120 * - [CopyInsertable][]: Copy constructor
121 * - [DefaultConstructible][]: Default constructor
122 * - [EmplaceConstructible][]: Constructor selected by the given arguments
123 * - [MoveAssignable][]: Move assignment operator
124 * - [CopyAssignable][]: Copy assignment operator
125 *
126 * Furthermore, not `noexcept` methods throws whatever the allocator throws
127 * if memory allocation fails. Such methods also throw `length_error` if the capacity
128 * exceeds `max_size()`.
129 *
130 * **Remark**: If a method invalidates some iterators, it also invalidates references
131 * and pointers to the elements pointed by the invalidated iterators.
132 *
133 *! \tparam Options A type produced from \c boost::container::devector_options.
134 *
135 * [SequenceContainer]: http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/concept/SequenceContainer
136 * [ReversibleContainer]: http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/concept/ReversibleContainer
137 * [AllocatorAwareContainer]: http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/concept/AllocatorAwareContainer
138 * [DefaultInsertable]: http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/concept/DefaultInsertable
139 * [MoveInsertable]: http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/concept/MoveInsertable
140 * [CopyInsertable]: http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/concept/CopyInsertable
141 * [Erasable]: http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/concept/Erasable
142 * [DefaultConstructible]: http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/concept/DefaultConstructible
143 * [Destructible]: http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/concept/Destructible
144 * [EmplaceConstructible]: http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/concept/EmplaceConstructible
145 * [MoveAssignable]: http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/concept/MoveAssignable
146 * [CopyAssignable]: http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/concept/CopyAssignable
147 */
148 template < typename T, class A BOOST_CONTAINER_DOCONLY(= void), class Options BOOST_CONTAINER_DOCONLY(= void)>
149 class devector
150 {

197 25x static size_type to_internal_capacity(size_type desired_capacity)
198 {
199 25x const size_type rounder = devector_min_free_fraction - 2u;
200 25x const size_type divisor = devector_min_free_fraction - 1u;
201 25x size_type const nc = ((desired_capacity + rounder) / divisor) * devector_min_free_fraction;
202 25x BOOST_ASSERT(desired_capacity <= (nc - nc / devector_min_free_fraction));
203 25x return nc;
204 }

330 /**
331 * **Effects**: Constructs a devector equal to the range `[first,last)`, using the specified allocator.
332 *
333 * **Requires**: `T` shall be [EmplaceConstructible] into `*this` from `*first`. If the specified
334 * iterator does not meet the forward iterator requirements, `T` shall also be [MoveInsertable]
335 * into `*this`.
336 *
337 * **Postcondition**: `size() == boost::container::iterator_distance(first, last)
338 *
339 * **Exceptions**: Strong exception guarantee.
340 *
341 * **Complexity**: Makes only `N` calls to the copy constructor of `T` (where `N` is the distance between `first`
342 * and `last`), at most one allocation and no reallocations if iterators first and last are of forward,
343 * bidirectional, or random access categories. It makes `O(N)` calls to the copy constructor of `T`
344 * and `O(log(N)) reallocations if they are just input iterators.
345 *
346 * **Remarks**: Each iterator in the range `[first,last)` shall be dereferenced exactly once,
347 * unless an exception is thrown.
348 *
349 * [EmplaceConstructible]: http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/concept/EmplaceConstructible
350 * [MoveInsertable]: http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/concept/MoveInsertable
351 */
352 template <class InputIterator>
353 24x devector(InputIterator first, InputIterator last, const allocator_type& allocator = allocator_type()
354 //Input iterators
355 BOOST_CONTAINER_DOCIGN(BOOST_MOVE_I typename dtl::disable_if_or
356 < void
357 BOOST_MOVE_I dtl::is_convertible<InputIterator BOOST_MOVE_I size_type>
358 BOOST_MOVE_I dtl::is_not_input_iterator<InputIterator>
359 >::type * = 0)
360 )
361 24x : m_(allocator)
362 {
363 BOOST_CONTAINER_TRY{
364 1688x while (first != last) {
365 1664x this->emplace_back(*first++);
366 }
367 24x BOOST_ASSERT(invariants_ok());
368 }
369 ✗ BOOST_CONTAINER_CATCH(...){
370 ✗ this->destroy_elements(m_.buffer + m_.front_idx, m_.buffer + m_.back_idx);
371 ✗ this->deallocate_buffer();
372 }
373 BOOST_CONTAINER_CATCH_END
374 24x }

503 /**
504 * **Effects**: Copies elements of `x` to `*this`. Previously
505 * held elements get copy assigned to or destroyed.
506 *
507 * **Requires**: `T` shall be [CopyInsertable] into `*this`.
508 *
509 * **Postcondition**: `this->size() == x.size()`, the elements of
510 * `*this` are copies of elements in `x` in the same order.
511 *
512 * **Returns**: `*this`.
513 *
514 * **Exceptions**: Strong exception guarantee if `T` is `NothrowConstructible`
515 * and the allocator is allowed to be propagated
516 * ([propagate_on_container_copy_assignment] is true),
517 * Basic exception guarantee otherwise.
518 *
519 * **Complexity**: Linear in the size of `x` and `*this`.
520 *
521 * [CopyInsertable]: http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/concept/CopyInsertable
522 * [propagate_on_container_copy_assignment]: http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/memory/allocator_traits
523 */

526 {

528 66x if (this == &x) { return *this; } // skip self
529
530 66x const bool do_propagate = allocator_traits_type::propagate_on_container_copy_assignment::value;
531 BOOST_IF_CONSTEXPR(do_propagate)
532 {
533 2x allocator_type &this_alloc = this->get_allocator_ref();
534 2x const allocator_type &other_alloc = x.get_allocator_ref();
535 2x if (this_alloc != other_alloc)
536 {
537 // new allocator cannot free existing storage
538 2x this->clear();
539 2x this->deallocate_buffer();
540 2x m_.capacity = 0u;
541 2x m_.buffer = pointer();
542 }
543 dtl::bool_<do_propagate> flag;
544 2x dtl::assign_alloc(this_alloc, other_alloc, flag);
545 }
546
547 66x size_type n = x.size();
548 66x if (m_.capacity >= n) {
549 54x this->overwrite_buffer(x.begin(), x.end());
550 }
551 else {
552 12x this->allocate_and_copy_range(x.begin(), x.end());
553 }
554
555 66x BOOST_ASSERT(invariants_ok());
556
557 66x return *this;
558 }

3049 //! <b>Effects</b>: Erases all elements that compare equal to v from the container c.
3050 //!
3051 //! <b>Complexity</b>: Linear.
3052 template <class T, class A, class O, class U>
3053 20x inline typename devector<T, A, O>::size_type erase(devector<T, A, O>& c, const U& v)
3054 {
3055 20x typename devector<T, A, O>::size_type old_size = c.size();
3056 20x c.erase(boost::container::remove(c.begin(), c.end(), v), c.end());
3057 20x return old_size - c.size();
3058 }

3060 //! <b>Effects</b>: Erases all elements that satisfy the predicate pred from the container c.
3061 //!
3062 //! <b>Complexity</b>: Linear.
3063 template <class T, class A, class O, class Pred>
3064 20x inline typename devector<T, A, O>::size_type erase_if(devector<T, A, O>& c, Pred pred)
3065 {
3066 20x typename devector<T, A, O>::size_type old_size = c.size();
3067 20x c.erase(boost::container::remove_if(c.begin(), c.end(), pred), c.end());
3068 20x return old_size - c.size();
3069 }
